2607.07500.title: TimEE: End-to-end Time Series Classification via In-Context Learning
2607.07500.paper_summary: Time series classification (TSC) is dominated by a two-stage paradigm: train a feature encoder -- either from scratch on the target dataset or via pretraining on large corpora -- and then fit a task-specific classifier on top. While effective, this decoupling optimizes representation learning independently of the classification objective, requires per-dataset training, and prevents the model from exploiting label information during inference. We introduce TimEE, a 4.5M-parameter foundation model for end-to-end TSC via in-context learning. Given a labeled support set and a query time series, TimEE directly outputs a predicted class distribution in a single forward pass with no per-dataset training required. Following the prior-data fitted network (PFN) framework, TimEE is meta-trained exclusively on synthetic TSC tasks, where each task contains time series with distinct class identities arising from structured distributional shifts in the generative process. Despite seeing no real time series during pre-training, TimEE ranks first in ROC AUC (and third on accuracy) on the UCR benchmark among all compared methods, which include both foundation models and supervised deep learning baselines. To our knowledge, TimEE is the first purely synthetic-pretrained model to reach state-of-the-art performance on the UCR benchmark. These results establish end-to-end ICL with synthetic priors as a compelling, largely unexplored direction for TSC, with scaling, prior design, and richer generation mechanisms as natural avenues for improvement. Code is publicly available at http://github.com/automl/timee.
2607.07500.paper_summary_zh: 時間序列分類（TSC）主要受到兩階段範式的主導：訓練一個特徵編碼器——要麼從頭開始在目標數據集上訓練，要麼通過在大型語料庫上進行預訓練——然後在其上擬合一個特定任務的分類器。雖然這種方法有效，但這種解耦使得表示學習獨立於分類目標進行優化，需要針對每個數據集進行訓練，並且在推斷過程中無法利用標籤信息。我們介紹了TimEE，一個擁有450萬參數的基礎模型，通過上下文學習實現端到端的TSC。給定一個標記的支持集和一個查詢時間序列，TimEE在單次前向傳遞中直接輸出預測的類別分佈，無需針對每個數據集進行訓練。根據先前數據擬合網絡（PFN）框架，TimEE僅在合成TSC任務上進行元訓練，其中每個任務包含來自生成過程中結構性分佈變化的不同類別身份的時間序列。儘管在預訓練期間未見過真實的時間序列，TimEE在UCR基準上在所有比較方法中排名第一的ROC AUC（準確率第三），這些方法包括基礎模型和監督式深度學習基準。據我們所知，TimEE是第一個純合成預訓練模型，在UCR基準上達到最先進的性能。這些結果確立了具有合成先驗的端到端ICL作為TSC的一個引人注目的、大多數未被探索的方向，擴展、先驗設計和更豐富的生成機制是改進的自然途徑。代碼可在http://github.com/automl/timee公開獲取。
